uutiset.t: Fifpro criticises Bayern Munich for Musiala comments
uutiset.s: Football players' union Fifpro says it is concerned by German club Bayern Munich's comments about Jamal Musiala's contract.

uutiset.t: Leeds 'created piece of history' in Chelsea win - Farke
uutiset.s: Leeds United manager Daniel Farke is delighted his side "created a piece of history" following their 4-1 win against Chelsea, their first at Stamford Bridge since 1999.

uutiset.t: Alcaraz battles back against Shelton to reach final
uutiset.s: Carlos Alcaraz will have the chance to end his wait for a first ATP Finals title after completing a superb comeback victory over Ben Shelton.

uutiset.t: Ex-captain Moody joins England in emotional haka response
uutiset.s: Former England captain Lewis Moody joins the current team to face New Zealand's haka in an emotional start to Saturday's Test match at Allianz Stadium.

uutiset.t: England beat New Zealand by record margin
uutiset.s: England stun New Zealand, beating the three-time world champions by 25 points - compounding the All Blacks' disappointment after their loss to Wales last week.

uutiset.t: McConnell shines as 11-try Scotland dismantle Japan
uutiset.s: A Liam McConnell hat-trick inspires Scotland in an 11-try Nations Championship rout of Japan at Murrayfield.

uutiset.t: Superb England run up record win over New Zealand
uutiset.s: England's revival roars up a gear as they beat New Zealand by a record margin after former captain Lewis Moody leads the hosts' response to the haka.

uutiset.s: Manchester City spent £327m overhauling their midfield in the summer - but how does Enzo Maresca find the right balance?

uutiset.s: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca says Erling Haaland's first-half goal against Fulham should have stood.

uutiset.s: How Manchester City and Fulham players rated in their Premier League match.

uutiset.t: 'Best in world' Price set for Cardiff stadium fight
uutiset.s: Lauren Price is one of the most decorated fighters in British boxing history and is now set to headline a summer stadium show in Cardiff.

uutiset.s: England captain Harry Kane will be out "for the next few months" after undergoing surgery on torn ankle ligaments sustained during Bayern Munich's 1-1 Bundesliga draw with Cologne on Friday.

uutiset.t: England call up McKinney for South Africa Tests
uutiset.s: England call up uncapped Durham opener Ben McKinney for the Test tour of South Africa after Jacob Bethell's injury withdrawal.

uutiset.s: Unlikely Australia international Nikhil Chaudhary rattles England and secures a tense and tetchy final-over victory in the first T20.

uutiset.t: Lehmann again denies knowing about sandpaper plot
uutiset.s: Former Australia coach Darren Lehmann says he and his staff did not encourage players to use sandpaper on the ball in 2018 despite detailed claims by Cameron Bancroft.
